title: Broken on Arrival: Non-Functional Quantized LLM Artifacts in Public Model Registries and How to Catch Them
author: Aditi Patodiya
description: Developers download quantized large language models (LLMs) from public registries to run them locally. None of the registries we examined documented functional testing of their files. summary: Developers download quantized large language models (LLMs) from public registries to run them locally. None of the registries we examined documented functional testing of their files.
takeaways: We release the audit data and the quantcheck tool and recommend screening low-bit tags before publication, then calibrating or withholding failures.
None of the registries we examined documented functional testing of their files.
We tested all 305 eligible code-capable GGUF tags (the llama.cpp format) across 15 model lines in the official Ollama library, plus 22 popular Hugging Face community files.
